mapper.select: SELECT dm_room_id AS dmRoomId, pair_key AS pairKey, user_low AS userLow, user_high AS userHigh, low_last_read_message_id AS lowLastReadMessageId, high_last_read_message_id AS highLastReadMessageId, low_left_at AS lowLeftAt, high_left_at AS highLeftAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM ultary_dm_room WHERE pair_key = #{pairKey}

SELECT dm_room_id AS dmRoomId, pair_key AS pairKey, user_low AS userLow, user_high AS userHigh, low_last_read_message_id AS lowLastReadMessageId, high_last_read_message_id AS highLastReadMessageId, low_left_at AS lowLeftAt, high_left_at AS highLeftAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM ultary_dm_room WHERE dm_room_id = #{dmRoomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_dm_room (pair_key, user_low, user_high) VALUES (#{pairKey}, #{userLow}, #{userHigh})
mapper.update: UPDATE ultary_dm_room SET low_left_at = IF(user_low = #{userNo}, NULL, low_left_at), high_left_at = IF(user_high = #{userNo}, NULL, high_left_at) WHERE dm_room_id = #{dmRoomId} AND (user_low = #{userNo} OR user_high = #{userNo})

UPDATE ultary_dm_room SET low_left_at = IF(user_low = #{userNo}, NOW(), low_left_at), high_left_at = IF(user_high = #{userNo}, NOW(), high_left_at) WHERE dm_room_id = #{dmRoomId} AND (user_low = #{userNo} OR user_high = #{userNo})

UPDATE ultary_dm_room SET low_last_read_message_id = IF(user_low = #{userNo}, GREATEST(IFNULL(low_last_read_message_id, 0), #{messageId}), low_last_read_message_id), high_last_read_message_id = IF(user_high = #{userNo}, GREATEST(IFNULL(high_last_read_message_id, 0), #{messageId}), high_last_read_message_id) WHERE dm_room_id = #{dmRoomId} AND (user_low = #{userNo} OR user_high = #{userNo})
UPDATE ultary_dm_room SET low_left_at = IF(user_low = #{senderUserNo}, low_left_at, NULL), high_left_at = IF(user_high = #{senderUserNo}, high_left_at, NULL) WHERE dm_room_id = #{dmRoomId}
mapper.sql: r.dm_room_id AS dmRoomId, IF(r.user_low = #{userNo}, r.user_high, r.user_low) AS peerUserNo, u.nickname AS peerNickname, ( SELECT rp.profile_file_id FROM ultary_pet rp WHERE rp.user_no = u.user_no AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.profile_file_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rp.priority ASC, rp.pet_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS profileFileId, m.body AS lastBody, m.share_type AS lastShareType, IFNULL(m.created_at, r.created_at) AS lastMessageAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ultary_dm_message um WHERE um.dm_room_id = r.dm_room_id AND um.sender_user_no <> #{userNo} AND um.dm_message_id > IFNULL( IF(r.user_low = #{userNo}, r.low_last_read_message_id, r.high_last_read_message_id), 0) ) AS unreadCount

FROM ultary_dm_room r INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = IF(r.user_low = #{userNo}, r.user_high, r.user_low) AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN ultary_dm_message m ON m.dm_message_id = ( SELECT MAX(x.dm_message_id) FROM ultary_dm_message x WHERE x.dm_room_id = r.dm_room_id ) WHERE (r.user_low = #{userNo} OR r.user_high = #{userNo}) AND IF(r.user_low = #{userNo}, r.low_left_at, r.high_left_at) IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_user_block b WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND ( (b.blocker_user_no = #{userNo} AND b.blocked_user_no = u.user_no) OR (b.blocked_user_no = #{userNo} AND b.blocker_user_no = u.user_no) ) )

SELECT f.user_no AS author, p.user_no AS target, fp.created_at AS tagged_at FROM ultary_feed_pet fp JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = fp.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 JOIN ultary_pet p ON p.pet_id = fp.pet_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE fp.created_at >= #{cutoff} AND (f.user_no = #{userNo} OR p.user_no = #{userNo}) UNION ALL SELECT f.user_no, p.user_no, fm.created_at FROM ultary_feed_media_mention fm JOIN ultary_feed_media m ON m.feed_media_id = fm.feed_media_id JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = m.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 JOIN ultary_pet p ON p.pet_id = fm.pet_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE fm.created_at >= #{cutoff} AND (f.user_no = #{userNo} OR p.user_no = #{userNo})
mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname, (SELECT p.profile_file_id FROM ultary_pet p WHERE p.user_no = u.user_no AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.profile_file_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.priority, p.pet_id LIMIT 1) AS profileFileId, r.dm_room_id AS dmRoomId, MAX(CASE WHEN e.kind = 'DM' THEN e.at END) AS lastMessageAt, MAX(CASE WHEN e.kind = 'OWN_MENTION' THEN e.at END) AS ownMentionAt, MAX(CASE WHEN e.kind = 'IN_MENTION' THEN e.at END) AS incomingMentionAt, MAX(CASE WHEN e.kind = 'FEED_PARTICIPANT' THEN e.at END) AS participantAt, MAX(CASE WHEN e.kind = 'OWN_STORY' THEN e.at END) AS ownStoryTagAt, MAX(CASE WHEN e.kind = 'OWN_FEED' THEN e.at END) AS ownFeedTagAt, MAX(CASE WHEN e.kind = 'IN_STORY' THEN e.at END) AS taggedInStoryAt, MAX(CASE WHEN e.kind = 'IN_FEED' THEN e.at END) AS taggedInFeedAt, MAX(CASE WHEN e.kind = 'FOLLOW' THEN e.at END) AS followedAt, MAX(CASE WHEN e.kind = 'FOLLOWER' THEN e.at END) AS followerAt FROM (
SELECT #{userNo} AS peer, 'SELF' AS kind, #{cutoff} AS at UNION ALL
SELECT IF(r.user_low = #{userNo}, r.user_high, r.user_low) AS peer, 'DM' AS kind, MAX(m.created_at) AS at FROM ultary_dm_room r JOIN ultary_dm_message m ON m.dm_room_id = r.dm_room_id WHERE r.user_low = #{userNo} OR r.user_high = #{userNo} GROUP BY r.dm_room_id, r.user_low, r.user_high UNION ALL SELECT IF(s.user_no = #{userNo}, p.user_no, s.user_no), IF(s.user_no = #{userNo}, 'OWN_STORY', 'IN_STORY'), sm.created_at FROM ultary_story_mention sm JOIN ultary_story s ON s.story_id = sm.story_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 JOIN ultary_pet p ON p.pet_id = sm.pet_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sm.created_at >= #{cutoff} AND (s.user_no = #{userNo} OR p.user_no = #{userNo}) UNION ALL SELECT IF(t.author = #{userNo}, t.target, t.author), IF(t.author = #{userNo}, 'OWN_FEED', 'IN_FEED'), t.tagged_at FROM () t UNION ALL
SELECT c.user_no, 'FEED_PARTICIPANT', c.created_at FROM ultary_feed_comment c WHERE c.feed_id=#{feedId} AND c.is_deleted=0 UNION ALL SELECT r.user_no, 'FEED_PARTICIPANT', r.created_at FROM ultary_feed_reply r JOIN ultary_feed_comment pc ON pc.feed_comment_id=r.feed_comment_id WHERE pc.feed_id=#{feedId} AND pc.is_deleted=0 AND r.is_deleted=0 UNION ALL
SELECT IF(COALESCE(c.user_no,r.user_no)=#{userNo}, cm.mentioned_user_no, COALESCE(c.user_no,r.user_no)), IF(COALESCE(c.user_no,r.user_no)=#{userNo}, 'OWN_MENTION','IN_MENTION'), cm.created_at FROM ultary_feed_comment_mention cm LEFT JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON c.feed_comment_id=cm.feed_comment_id LEFT JOIN ultary_feed_reply r ON r.feed_reply_id=cm.feed_reply_id LEFT JOIN ultary_feed_comment pc ON pc.feed_comment_id=r.feed_comment_id JOIN ultary_feed mf ON mf.feed_id=COALESCE(c.feed_id,pc.feed_id) AND mf.is_deleted=0 WHERE cm.mentioned_user_no IS NOT NULL AND cm.created_at >= #{cutoff} AND ((cm.feed_comment_id IS NOT NULL AND c.is_deleted=0) OR (cm.feed_reply_id IS NOT NULL AND r.is_deleted=0 AND pc.is_deleted=0)) AND (COALESCE(c.user_no,r.user_no)=#{userNo} OR cm.mentioned_user_no=#{userNo}) AND COALESCE(c.user_no,r.user_no) <> cm.mentioned_user_no UNION ALL SELECT receiver_user_no, 'FOLLOW', COALESCE(accepted_at, requested_at) FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE requester_user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' UNION ALL SELECT requester_user_no, 'FOLLOW', COALESCE(followed_back_at, accepted_at, requested_at) FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE receiver_user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND followed_back = 1 UNION ALL SELECT requester_user_no, 'FOLLOWER', COALESCE(accepted_at, requested_at) FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE receiver_user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' UNION ALL SELECT receiver_user_no, 'FOLLOWER', COALESCE(followed_back_at, accepted_at, requested_at) FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE requester_user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND followed_back = 1 ) e JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = e.peer AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN ultary_dm_room r ON r.user_low = LEAST(#{userNo}, u.user_no) AND r.user_high = GREATEST(#{userNo}, u.user_no) WHERE 1 = 1
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ultary_pet tp WHERE tp.user_no = u.user_no AND tp.is_deleted = 0) AND (u.user_no = #{userNo} OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_user_privacy pr WHERE pr.user_no = u.user_no AND pr.allow_tag = 0))
AND u.user_no != #{userNo}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ultary_user_privacy mp WHERE mp.user_no=u.user_no AND mp.allow_mention=0)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ultary_user_block b WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND ((b.blocker_user_no = #{userNo} AND b.blocked_user_no = u.user_no) OR (b.blocked_user_no = #{userNo} AND b.blocker_user_no = u.user_no)))
AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(u.nickname)) > 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_pet sp WHERE sp.user_no = u.user_no AND sp.is_deleted = 0 AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(sp.mention_id)) > 0))
GROUP BY u.user_no, u.nickname, r.dm_room_id
mapper.sql: msg.dm_message_id AS dmMessageId, msg.sender_user_no AS senderUserNo, msg.body AS body, msg.share_type AS shareType, msg.feed_id AS feedId, msg.feed_media_id AS feedMediaId, msg.story_id AS storyId, msg.created_at AS createdAt, f.content AS feedContent, f.is_deleted AS feedDeleted, COALESCE(f.user_no, s.user_no) AS authorUserNo, au.nickname AS authorNickname, ( SELECT rp.profile_file_id FROM ultary_pet rp WHERE rp.user_no = COALESCE(f.user_no, s.user_no) AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.profile_file_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rp.priority ASC, rp.pet_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS authorProfileFileId, fm.sort_order AS mediaIndex, fm.file_id AS mediaFileId, fm.thumbnail_file_id AS mediaThumbnailFileId, fm.media_type AS mediaType, s.is_deleted AS storyDeleted, s.file_id AS storyFileId, s.thumbnail_file_id AS storyThumbnailFileId, s.media_type AS storyMediaType

FROM ultary_dm_message msg LEFT JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = msg.feed_id LEFT JOIN ultary_feed_media fm ON fm.feed_media_id = msg.feed_media_id LEFT JOIN ultary_story s ON s.story_id = msg.story_id LEFT JOIN ultary_user au ON au.user_no = COALESCE(f.user_no, s.user_no)
